question: How does SO(3) pool size affect the closest-to-truth member of the T_A=25 survival cloud on seed 28, and is the gain RNG-robust?
hypothesis: Densifying the pool from 100k to 400k drops the closest-to-truth survival-cloud member into the robust regime on seed 28.
narrative_md: Densifying the SO(3) pool 100k -> 400k drops the median closest-to-truth survival-cloud member on seed 28 from 10.96deg (bimodal cliff) to 2.32deg (robust). But variance is high: at 400k it ranges 1.41-8.33deg across 3 RNGs and a bad-RNG 'donut hole' persists at 800k. Fix is multi-RNG union / true Sobol-Shoemake -- sample_so3_pool's 'Sobol' name is a misnomer (Haar-uniform random). Measures closest-geodesic-to-truth -- oracle-leak, N=1.
